The recent-regime window: the day after the reserved bar range ends, through the global cutoff. 112 sessions (measured by V11's export, 2026-09-02). Read by V11 and V12 - it is DEV-legal but no longer unseen.

dev_rule: DEV = a session inside dev_ranges AND inside the queried source's own sources[].dev_ranges. Anything else is RESERVED. Stated positively on purpose: 'not reserved' is how the three burns happened - a lane that never asked the lock read whatever the file it opened contained. A source whose coverage starts after a dev range starts simply has a shorter dev window; it never inherits a wider one.
source_rule: Every source carries its OWN boundary because coverage differs by years and because two cutoffs are in play (this lock's 2026-08-12 and the X1 card's 2026-08-14). Where they differ the STRICTER date governs - c7_recorder.py already does this and it is now the written rule. A source marked guarded_by: null has no executable guard yet and may not be read by a screen until one exists (A12.6).
